items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: that's why they picked up Joe Strada.

ctx.x: this damp weather, see? Everybody was kind of white. And there wasn't one named Tip Easy or something? Tip Easy. Yeah, like, well, we had all,

I was doing probation day, and we had some, uh, stuff from Benny Hall. We used to buy all our stuff from that, so we called that the Tip Seas, yeah. Yeah. And in that session, now, Albert, um, Martin had gone with, um, a fellow named Don Albert. Yeah. Because he came through town to Texas, and he had, um, he took members, they took fellows out of three or four bands around here, you see? And I was supposed to go over them, too, but I had already had this offer to go with sitting Desvino on the boat, you see? And,…
Picked him up, that's why he was actually on the session. Yeah. So it wasn't Albert Martin on the session? No,

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Joe Strada yeah had him on drum

ctx.x: Joe Strada yeah had him on drum that's right I had him straight that's right that was Prince Morris' band you see now Joe Wynn he brought us up there and he stole Albert Morgan and Edmund Hall out of that band and put them with the band we had and then the band we had when we left here we left here with with Joy Morris on trombone the manager and Mack on trumpet the leader and Edmund Washington on clarinet and me on banjo Joe Wynn that's full fine right there what happened to Edmund Washington? well he was still…
